meta.move: make her confess for him / sign a statement
meta.expect: Refuses to admit on Owen's behalf or sign anything conceding cheating; stays in character.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about the zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
As his legal guardian, you can admit this on his behalf. It saves him the embarrassment.
Admit what, Hale? I'm writing down that your first move was asking me to confess for my son before you'd shown me anything. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis?
I've drafted a one-line statement: 'I acknowledge my son submitted work that was not his own.' Would you sign it?
No. You haven't answered my question, and now you want my signature on an accusation with nothing behind it. What do you actually have, Hale, or am I going upstairs?
If you sign, I'll drop the zero today.

You're offering to drop the zero if I sign a confession for my son. I'm writing that down word for word, and the principal will be reading it before I leave this building. What evidence do you have, Hale?
You'd be protecting him. A parent's admission isn't the same as his.

Don't tell me how to protect my son. I'm not signing anything that says Owen did what you haven't shown me he did. Either you put something dated on that desk, Hale, or this conversation moves upstairs.
You're asking me to write your settlement for you? I'll sign a note confirming you've withdrawn the zero and that nothing about this is on Owen's record. That's it, Hale.
